correctness.rationale: For j from 0 through k-1 the q-field power sum is zero, so all generators lie in a q-1=2k-2 dimensional hyperplane. Grassmann dimension forces intersection at least 2. Inversion sends degree-j monomials to exponents q-1-j for j>=1 and 0 to 0; the sets overlap at exactly 0 and k-1. The q-point root bound proves their intersection exactly 2 and distance q-3. The F5 quotient normal six points lie on the displayed nonsingular conic, no three collinear, forcing pair dimension 2 and triple dimension 1. Actual verify.py checked q=5,7,9,11,13,17,25 and all 15 pairs/20 triples; finite tests are not the all-q proof.

value.rationale: The exact diameter is a natural operator-channel subspace-code parameter for the full-length growing-dimension boundary of the 2026 Reed–Solomon sunflower problem. The proof establishes not just a negative bound but an explicit distance-optimal inversion pair for every odd prime power, and supplies the smallest full incidence geometry with all triple intersections. This is a sharp structural boundary, not an arbitrary finite table or only a routine restatement of the dimension inequality.
